title: App generator
description: Generates a runnable backend project from the registered resource models

models.description: Comma-separated model names (defaults to all registered models)
models.x-prompt: ¿Qué modelos incluye? (separados por comas; vacío = todos)

skipInstall.description: Skip npm install and the Spartan UI materialisation

ui.description: Component library used by the emitted frontend

plugins.description: Comma-separated optional plugins (auth, email, observability); migrations is built in
plugins.x-prompt: ¿Qué plugins añado? (auth, email, observability — separados por comas; 'none' para ninguno)
